description_en: Appends entries in batches to the virus scan blacklists and whitelists for a specified operating system without overwriting existing entries. Quotas are calculated independently for each combination of matching dimension and list type. Each combination allows a maximum of 10,000 whitelist entries and 1,000 blacklist entries. If the quota is exceeded after appending, the entire batch fails
description_zh: 向指定操作系统的病毒扫描黑白名单批量追加条目，不会覆盖已有条目。配额按匹配维度与名单类型的每个组合独立计算，每个组合下白名单最多10000条、黑名单最多1000条，追加后超出配额时整批失败
name: AddVirusScanAdditionalLists

parameters.help_en:
The operating system type for which the list takes effect. Valid values:
windows: Windows.
macOS: macOS
parameters.help_zh:
名单生效的操作系统类型。取值：
windows：Windows系统。
macOS：macOS系统
parameters.name: dev_type

fields.help_en:
The matching dimension of the list entry. Valid values:
FileSuffix: matches by file name extension.
FileName: matches by file name.
FolderName: matches by folder name.
FilePath: matches by file path.
FileMd5: matches by file MD5 value
fields.help_zh:
名单条目的匹配维度。取值：
FileSuffix：按文件扩展名匹配。
FileName：按文件名匹配。
FolderName：按文件夹名匹配。
FilePath：按文件路径匹配。
FileMd5：按文件MD5值匹配
fields.name: additional_type

fields.help_en: The content of the list entry. The value cannot exceed 255 characters. The meaning is determined by AdditionalType: when AdditionalType is set to FileSuffix, specify a file name extension. When set to FileName, specify a file name. When set to FolderName, specify a folder name. When set to FilePath, specify a file path. When set to FileMd5, specify the MD5 value of a file
fields.help_zh: 名单条目内容，长度不超过255个字符。含义由AdditionalType决定：AdditionalType取值为FileSuffix时填写文件扩展名，取值为FileName时填写文件名，取值为FolderName时填写文件夹名，取值为FilePath时填写文件路径，取值为FileMd5时填写文件的MD5值
fields.name: detail

fields.help_en:
The list type. Valid values:
Blacklist: blacklist. Files that match are directly identified as virus files.
Whitelist: whitelist. Files that match are excluded from virus detection
fields.help_zh:
名单类型。取值：
Blacklist：黑名单，命中的文件直接判定为病毒文件。
Whitelist：白名单，命中的文件不参与病毒检测
fields.name: list_type

parameters.help_en: The list of entries to append. At least one entry is required
parameters.help_zh: 待追加的名单条目列表，至少包含1个
parameters.name: additional_lists

ListIds.description_en: The list of IDs for the newly added entries. The order is consistent with AdditionalLists in the request
ListIds.description_zh: 本次新增的名单条目ID列表，顺序与请求中的AdditionalLists一致
